description: Create a budget-capped agent session. All chat completions using the returned session_id are charged against this budget. Returns the session object including id and budget details.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier for attribution and AP2 mandate wiring

budget_usd.description: Session budget in USD (e.g. 1.00 for $1.00). The session deactivates once this is exhausted.

expires_in_hours.description: Session TTL in hours. Defaults to 24.

name: p402_create_session
